description: Read one UI skill by its id, as returned by mba_list_ui_skills or mba_create_ui_skill. A UI skill is NOT an agent skill (mba_list_agent_skills): an agent skill is instruction text that shapes what the agent says, a UI skill lets the agent send one kind of rich WhatsApp component and tells it when to send that component.

app_id.description: The 360dialog channel's app_id. Identifies which WhatsApp number the agent belongs to.

name: mba_get_ui_skill

component_type.description: The type of rich message this UI skill sends. Known values: carousel_quick_reply, carousel_url, cta_url, flow, image, interactive_list, interactive_reply_buttons, location, location_request.

created_at.description: The timestamp when the UI skill was created

flow_id.description: The identifier of the associated flow. Only present for flow skills

id.description: A unique identifier for the UI skill

instruction.description: A description telling the AI agent when to send this UI skill

status.description: Whether this UI skill is enabled and available to the AI agent. Known values: disabled, enabled.

title.description: A human-readable name for the UI skill

updated_at.description: The timestamp when the UI skill was last updated

title: Read a UI skill
